get.description: A fixture for PreMan's self-healing loop, and the only one here whose drift is on the way in. The published contract bounds `percent_off` to 0–100 and documents HTTP 422 for anything else; the handler declares no bounds and answers 200 for any integer, including 150 and -40. The repair is to enforce the range the schema already documents.

parameters.description: Percentage off the order total. Documented as 0–100.
parameters.name: percent_off

schema.description: Percentage off the order total. Documented as 0–100.
schema.title: Percent Off

get.description:
Liveness, for load balancers and uptime checks.

Answers `HealthResponse`: `status` is `ok` while the service is serving
traffic. Unlike `/ready` this does not wait on storage, so it stays
answerable while a dependency is down and can be polled cheaply.
